_meta.source: institutions.tech_profile (BuiltWith rollup) prevalence, cohort 128, filtered for oracle noise
_meta.scope: Full exhaustive sweep across 8 signal categories (Marketing Automation added per Joel 2026-07-16). Bounded corpus depth (~150 positives/vendor + shared negative sample).
_meta.oracle_caveat: BuiltWith = good POSITIVE, bad NEGATIVE oracle. neg_hit% is NOT precision. Several BuiltWith categories are miscategorized (see per-category _filtered notes) — the target lists below are HAND-CURATED to real signal vendors, NOT the raw BuiltWith category membership.

action_legend.validate: curated pattern already exists (CMS/Site Search/LMS/SIS) — run against corpus, confirm recall, tighten if weak
action_legend.build: no curated pattern yet — data-mine a tight signature from positives
action_legend.extend: category partial exists but this vendor is a gap — add it

CMS._note: Clean BuiltWith category. All high-volume vendors already curated.

Site Search._note: 16 vendors already curated (id 29). Confirm recall for the high-volume ones.

LMS._note: 55 vendors curated by UNI-138..142. BuiltWith has NO reliable LMS category, so positives oracle is weak here — validate by running existing patterns against the corpus and eyeballing hit-rate on known-LMS institutions, not BuiltWith labels.

SIS._note: 50 vendors curated by UNI-138..142. Same weak-oracle caveat as LMS.

CRM._note: Sparse BuiltWith category but Slate is THE HE admissions CRM. Only 3 vendors >=5 insts.

Chatbot._filtered_out: BuiltWith 'Chatbot' category is heavily polluted. EXCLUDED: robots.txt AI-bot-disallow directives (GPTBot Disallow 1805, Google Bard Disallow, Anthropic Claude Bot Disallow, Common Crawl, ByteDance, Apple AI, Facebook Bot, etc. — these are robots.txt entries, not chat) and video-conferencing (Zoom 1748, WebEx 764, Agora, 8x8).

Accessibility._filtered_out: BuiltWith 'Accessibility & QA' is dominated by PERFORMANCE/CACHING plugins, NOT accessibility. EXCLUDED: WP Rocket (610), W3 Total Cache (327), Redis Cache, Autoptimize, Smush/Smush Pro (image opt), LiteSpeed Cache, WP Super Cache, NitroPack, WP-Optimize, SiteGround Optimizer, EWWW Image Optimizer, ShortPixel, FlyingPress, Performance Lab, a3 Lazy Load, TwicPics, plus SEO (SmartCrawl, The SEO Framework) and error-monitoring (Rollbar, LogRocket).
Accessibility._note: signal_polarity='negative' applies to overlay widgets (UNI-137) — preserve on the overlays (UserWay/accessiBe/AudioEye/EqualWeb/Accessibility Helper); Siteimprove/Monsido/ReadSpeaker/Level Access are auditing/assistive, not overlays.

Marketing Automation._new_signal_category: Added as 8th signal category per Joel 2026-07-16. Needs a category-mapping.js id first (Task 3.0).
Marketing Automation._filtered_out: BuiltWith 'Marketing Automation' conflates real MA platforms with TRANSACTIONAL EMAIL INFRA. EXCLUDED as infra (not a marketing-platform signal): Amazon SES (1386), Mailgun (1012), SendGrid (931), Mandrill (476), SparkPost, Dyn, Elastic Email, Postmark, SMTP2GO, SocketLabs, MailChannels, MessageGears, Zoho ZeptoMail, MailerSend, turboSMTP, AuthSMTP, SMTP.com. Also excluded generic share widgets (AddThis, ShareThis, AddToAny).
